name: Battle for Ercaton: Robot Uprising
detailed_description:
• Battle For Ercaton: Robot Uprising is a story-driven first-person shooter that immerses you in a world of ruthless machines and hidden secrets on the planet Ercaton.
    The wind howls through metal ruins. Cold mechanical eyes watch your every move. A mysterious message that brought you to this planet will change your fate forever.

  • February 2078.
    Space traveler Liam Raynor intercepts a chilling message from an unknown planet. His attempt to investigate the source ends in disaster — his ship crashes during a violent electromagnetic storm. Stranded amidst the ruins of a former human colony, he faces a deadly threat: a relentless army of steel predators.

  • In the chaos, Liam is aided by a mysterious woman named Lexia, who clearly has her own motives.

  • In this desperate struggle for survival, you’ll have to uncover:

    • What happened to the thousands of colonists on Ercaton who vanished without a trace?
    • Why did the robots, once built to serve humanity, become ruthless hunters?
    • And most importantly — who sent the terrifying message that led you to this planet?

  • Every challenge will test your skill and creativity.

    Game Features:

  • 💥 Intense Combat
    Prepare for adrenaline-fueled firefights against a deadly mechanical army. From nimble drones to massive war machines — enemies lurk around every corner.

  • 🔫 Varied Arsenal
    Experience dynamic gunplay with a diverse selection of weapons, each with unique characteristics.

  • 🌌 Atmospheric Locations
    Explore haunting and dangerous corners of the abandoned colony — from ruined military bases and snow-covered futuristic structures to dark caves and forgotten underground laboratories where time stands still.

  • 🚀 Diverse Gameplay
    From classic FPS shootouts to thrilling aerial dogfights — each mission brings new challenges and unexpected twists.
